Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning expenditures for works of art.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to expenditures for works of art; amending RCW43.17.200; creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that one if itsforemost duties is the prioritization and wise use of taxpayer funds.During times of economic downturn, it is incumbent upon the legislatureto ensure limited state resources are spent prudently. Therefore, thelegislature intends to suspend spending on art related to capitalprojects for the remainder of the 20112013 biennium and the 20132015biennium.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.17.200 and 2005 c 36 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All state agencies including all state departments, boards,councils, commissions, and quasi public corporations ((shall)) mustallocate, as a nondeductible item, out of any moneys appropriated forthe original construction of any public building, an amount of onehalfof one percent of the appropriation to be expended by the Washingtonstate arts commission for the acquisition of works of art. However, no p. 1 SB 6004moneys may be expended, as of the effective date of this section, onthe acquisition of works of art for the 20112013 biennium through theend of the 20132015 biennium, unless a contract for the acquisition ofart existed prior to the effective date of this section. The works ofart may be placed on public lands, integral to or attached to a publicbuilding or structure, detached within or outside a public building orstructure, part of a portable exhibition or collection, part of atemporary exhibition, or loaned or exhibited in other publicfacilities. In addition to the cost of the works of art, the onehalfof one percent of the appropriation as provided herein ((shall)) mustbe used to provide for the administration of the visual arts program,including conservation of the state art collection, by the Washingtonstate arts commission and all costs for installation of the works ofart. For the purpose of this section building ((shall)) does notinclude highway construction sheds, warehouses or other buildings of atemporary nature.
